cases.name: the points of two dataframe columns, those without two numbers left out
cases.source:
<% df: stilo.dataframe {columns: ["x", "y"], rows: [[0, 0], [1, ""], [2, 1 + "a"], [3, 3]]} %>
<% stilo.charts.line {x: df.column "x", y: df.column "y"} %>

cases.name: a single point is drawn as a dot
missing or empty labels and title are not drawn
tick labels have no rounding noise
bad input gives an undefined value
cases.source: <% stilo.charts.line 3 %> <% stilo.charts.line {x: 1, y: [1]} %> <% stilo.charts.line {x: [1], y: "a"} %> <% stilo.charts.line {x: [1, 2], y: [1]} %> <% stilo.charts.line {x: ["a"], y: [1]} %>
